subject.title: fix: keep newline-mode reply paragraphs as separate channel bubbles

question: Should `chunkMode: "newline"` globally change from packing short adjacent paragraphs to always emitting one delivery per blank-line paragraph for every outbound text sender?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a pre-existing configured delivery behavior across channels and plugin senders to address a Codex automatic-reply regression; that compatibility scope is a product contract choice, not a mechanical review detail.

options.title: Keep generic packing; narrow the fix
options.body: Preserve the existing generic planner behavior and carry separate logical units only through the affected automatic visible-reply path.

options.title: Redefine newline mode globally
options.body: Accept one-send-per-paragraph behavior for all existing newline-mode users and document the delivery-volume and channel compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Keep generic packing; narrow the fix
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing generic planner behavior and carry separate logical units only through the affected automatic visible-reply path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects shared outbound delivery semantics and needs an owner familiar with its existing channel contract.
